Here is a comprehensive breakdown of photosynthesis, organized as (subject, predicate, object) triples.

### I. The General Process
1. (Photosynthesis, defines, energy conversion)
2. (Photoautotrophs, perform, photosynthesis)
3. (Plants, convert, solar energy)
4. (Light energy, becomes, chemical energy)
5. (Photosynthesis, produces, glucose)
6. (Photosynthesis, releases, oxygen)
7. (Carbon dioxide, enters, leaves)
8. (Water, enters, roots)

### II. The Cellular Location
9. (Chloroplasts, house, photosynthesis)
10. (Thylakoids, contain, chlorophyll)
11. (Chlorophyll, absorbs, blue light)
12. (Chlorophyll, absorbs, red light)
13. (Chlorophyll, reflects, green light)
14. (Stroma, fills, chloroplast interior)
15. (Granum, describes, thylakoid stacks)

### III. The Light-Dependent Reactions (The Photo Part)
16. (Light-dependent reactions, occur in, thylakoid membranes)
17. (Photons, strike, Photosystem II)
18. (Energy, excites, electrons)
19. (Water molecules, undergo, photolysis)
20. (Photolysis, produces, oxygen gas)
21. (Photolysis, releases, hydrogen ions)
22. (Electron Transport Chain, moves, excited electrons)
23. (Proton gradient, powers, ATP synthase)
24. (ATP synthase, synthesizes, ATP)
25. (NADP+, reduces to, NADPH)
26. (Light reactions, provide, chemical power)

### IV. The Light-Independent Reactions (The Calvin Cycle)
27. (Calvin Cycle, occurs in, stroma)
28. (RuBisCO, catalyzes, carbon fixation)
29. (Carbon dioxide, attaches to, RuBP)
30. (ATP, provides, activation energy)
31. (NADPH, provides, reducing power)
32. (3-PGA, converts to, G3P)
33. (G3P, forms, glucose)
34. (RuBP, undergoes, regeneration)

### V. Environmental Factors and Variations
35. (Light intensity, limits, reaction rate)
36. (Temperature, affects, enzyme activity)
37. (C4 plants, minimize, photorespiration)
38. (CAM plants, fix, carbon at night)
39. (Stomata, regulate, gas exchange)
40. (Transpiration, causes, water loss)

### VI. The Chemical Equation (Functional Representation)
41. (6CO2 + 6H2O, yields, C6H12O6 + 6O2)
42. (Reactants, include, carbon dioxide and water)
43. (Products, include, sugar and oxygen)
